actors.name: Nigel Farage
actors.blurb: Nigel Farage has resigned as the Member of Parliament for Clacton to trigger a by-election, aiming to reassert his political influence amid ongoing investigations into undeclared donations and financial controversies. His move is seen as a high-stakes gamble to rally support against the political establishment.

actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.blurb: Marine Le Pen has launched her campaign for the 2027 French presidential election despite a recent conviction for embezzling public funds. Her candidacy, announced after an appeals court reduced her ineligibility period, underscores her enduring influence within France's far-right political landscape.
